name: Harry Barker
bio: Harry Barker took Geo. Wilkes' place as engineer at the slaughter-house in August 1885. A year later he married Lena Eager at Dickinson and settled at the Cantonment.
mentions: Harry Barker takes Geo. Wilkes' place as engineer at the slaughter-house and Charles M. Tibbetts takes the positions of night engineer and watchman.
